description: This file implements the Warehouse plugin for a device management system, including device reset, info retrieval, front panel control, and hardware testing functionalities.

classes.name: Warehouse
classes.description: Main class implementing device management functionalities such as reset, info retrieval, front panel control, and hardware testing.

classes.name: LedInfo
classes.description: Helper class for managing front panel LED timing and state updates.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Warehouse plugin, registers event handlers, and checks for RFC feature enablement.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus communication and registers event handlers.

methods.name: resetDevice
methods.description: Performs device reset based on specified reset type and reboot suppression.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information by executing a shell script and parsing output.

methods.name: setFrontPanelState
methods.description: Sets the front panel LEDs to indicate download or error states.

methods.name: internalReset
methods.description: Performs an internal device reset if not in production mode.

methods.name: lightReset
methods.description: Resets the device's light indicators by executing a shell script.

methods.name: isClean
methods.description: Checks if certain files or directories are older than a specified age, indicating a clean state.

methods.name: executeHardwareTest
methods.description: Triggers hardware health testing via RFC parameters.

methods.name: getHardwareTestResults
methods.description: Retrieves hardware test results via RFC parameters.
